summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and the refactored segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers, with updated callers and four new test files. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Lint-level checks (line length, trailing whitespace, file endings, unused imports) were done by inspection only. Still unverified: ignite 0.3.0 acceptance of the classification completion hook, and the EventAccumulator-based tag assertions in the plot tests. Changed: monai/data/csv_saver.py and nifti_saver.py (new); nifti_writer.py default dtype; visualize/img2tensorboard.py; handlers/segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py, tensorboard_handlers.py; examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py and unet_evaluation_dict.py and tests/integration_sliding_window.py (output_path to output_dir); tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py (passes filename). New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Docs were not updated, and test_handler_tb_image.py was not changed, so index selection is only covered indirectly.
